slides.label: Bhrigu Nandi Nadi, as a story
slides.title:
When the teacher
meets the monk
slides.subtitle: Who walks in front decides the story

slides.label: Two characters
slides.title: Meet the cast
slides.closing:
Graha means “the one who grabs”:
each grabs a part of your life

slides.label: Rule 1 · Same sign
slides.title: Same room
body: When two grahas sit in one sign, they share a room

Their stories mix: the teacher brings the books,
the monk asks what you'll keep
slides.closing:
In Nadi, sharing a sign
is the strongest link

slides.label: Rule 2 · Degrees
slides.title: Who walks in front
body: Inside the room, count the degrees
The graha with more degrees walks in front
The one behind takes on the leader's nature
slides.closing:
Same two grahas,
two different stories

slides.label: Monk in front
slides.title:
The teacher
becomes a monk
body:
You stop following advice you were given
and trust what you've lived
A mentor steps back; savings get given away

slides.label: Teacher in front
slides.title:
The monk
becomes a teacher
body:
What you went through quietly
becomes what you can teach
The quiet meditator opens a class

slides.label: Right now, in Leo
slides.title: This month's story
body:
31 Oct to 11 Nov: the monk has more degrees,
so the teacher turns monk

11 Nov to 5 Dec: the teacher walks in front,
so the monk turns teacher
slides.closing:
“Let go first,
then teach what's left”

slides.title:
Teacher and monk
in your chart?
slides.subtitle: See who walks in front
